title: The Great Harvest Perimeter / Whole Local Network Census
objective: Extend The Great Harvest from the Projects estate to every legitimate code-bearing root on Legion and T590, with explicit exclusions and cross-device lineage/content deduplication.
laws: Harvested repositories and loose-code roots are read-only evidence sources.
Every discovered local code root is classified; nothing disappears merely because it is duplicate or disposable.
Tool/plugin caches are explicit exclusions, not Harvest stock.
Cross-device duplicates collapse by lineage/content while preserving location provenance.
Live-only source is fingerprinted, never copied or promoted automatically.
Great Harvest remains quarry only: authorityGranted=false and automaticPromotion=false.
